paragraphs.text: Yasharn is a powerful elemental in the form of a giant boar that serves as the guardian of the Makindi Trenches region in Ondu , on the plane of Zendikar .

Yasharn came into existence as a direct consequence of Kozilek 's return, embodying the will of the Makindi Trenches themselves. Since its awakening, this elemental beast has roamed the area relentlessly, protecting the land from intrusion. The discovery and increased activity around the Skyclaves have drawn many explorers and adventurers to investigate the ancient kor ruins nearby, yet Yasharn's presence has effectively kept the Makindi Trenches untouched and wild.

Wherever Yasharn strides, vibrant new vegetation springs up from its footsteps — including unusual fruits and flowers previously unseen anywhere on Zendikar . These plants bloom briefly in radiant beauty before Yasharn turns back and crushes them beneath its immense, verdant hooves, reinforcing the cycle of destruction and renewal.
